receipt.public_excerpt:
This provides evidence for the potential role of
supervised fine-tuning in the emergence of political preferences within LLMs.

evidence_items.explanation: Political fine-tuning data steered later models, supporting a causal role for training data in related systems. The author also says the analysis cannot conclusively separate pretraining from fine-tuning as the source of observed preferences; it does not test the original ChatGPT.

unresolved_gaps: The retrieved experiments do not vary the training corpus of the February 2023 ChatGPT while holding other influences fixed.
The contemporaneous disclosure establishes learned biases but does not isolate the causes of political responses.
Neither literal copying nor an exclusive pretraining-corpus explanation is established, and neither is unambiguously asserted.
